title: Theros Beyond Death: card flavor text

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane of gods, heroes and poleis whose destiny is spoken of in the flavor text.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The starry divine realm whose majesty a merchant felt closer to when gazing at a unicorn.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God of the sun who places the sun in the Champion's hand and chooses mortals such as Daxos.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: Sea god who answers mortals who cry out to her and sends tritons to save them.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the dead who speaks of an inevitable end; his palace stands in Tizerus.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: God of horizons who foresaw the end and speaks of taking one's place among the stars.

entities.name: Klothys
entities.description: God of destiny who describes Kroxa and set out to mend the destiny of Theros.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: God of the hunt who watches over the creatures of the forest and appears amid a hundred beasts.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: God of slaughter, worshipped by minotaurs and rewarding brutality.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: God who, as a mortal, was the first to escape the Underworld.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God of the forge, devoted to by the flamespeakers of Akros.

entities.name: Pharika
entities.description: God who blesses snakes and is sought for her panacea.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: God of victory whose priests tell warriors he watches over them.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: God of harvests who says no power is too great to be undone.

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: God to whom cities offer tribute, who gives tangible tokens of favor to Meletian mages.

entities.name: Keranos
entities.description: God of storms whose displeasure is foretold by distant thunder.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker whose light is remembered by the people of Theros and who is haunted by Daxos's death.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: A mortal chosen by Heliod who rode a pegasus; his death stabbed into Elspeth's soul.

entities.name: Calix
entities.description: A figure who patiently followed Elspeth until their destined confrontation.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: Planeswalker whose minions plumb the depths of the ocean and the psyche.

entities.name: Kytheon
entities.description: A hero whom a veteran imagines keeping watch over them.

entities.name: Agios
entities.description: A warrior felled by a minotaur's blade but said to still be seen in battle.

entities.name: Callaphe
entities.description: Heroine of The Callapheia, saved by tritons after crying out to Thassa and guided by destiny.

entities.name: Renata
entities.description: A hunter of Setessa who led hunters against the Nessian boar and fought a minotaur.

entities.name: Dalakos
entities.description: An inventor whose Wings of Hubris worked until they did not.

entities.name: Perisophia
entities.description: A philosopher quoted on provoking the mountain and on ignorance.

entities.name: Siona
entities.description: Captain of the Pyleas who cried out to Thassa in a storm.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A polis whose greatest minds study at the Dekatia.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: A mountain polis of flamespeakers devoted to Purphoros.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: A polis with towers such as Hyrax Tower and the holy Summer Nexus grove.

entities.name: Skophos
entities.description: The minotaur polis with grand temples to Mogis.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: The realm of the dead in which memory and identity erode.

entities.name: Tizerus
entities.description: A bleak realm of the Underworld containing the palace of Erebos.

events.summary: Heliod chooses Daxos, who rides a pegasus without saddle or reins.
events.quote: Chosen by Heliod, Daxos approached the pegasus without fear, and rode it without saddle or reins.

events.summary: The memory of Daxos's death wounds Elspeth.
events.quote: The sharp memory of Daxos's death stabbed into Elspeth's soul.

events.summary: Calix patiently follows Elspeth until their destined confrontation.
events.quote: Calix was patient, steadily following Elspeth until their destined confrontation.

events.summary: Phenax became the first mortal to escape the Underworld, and later a god.
events.quote: As a mortal, Phenax was the first to escape the Underworld.

events.summary: Klothys sets out to mend the destiny of Theros.
events.quote: Klothys set out to mend the destiny of Theros, her fury guiding every stitch.

events.summary: Kruphix glimpses the end: Heliod's spear cast down and broken.
events.quote: Far-seeing Kruphix glimpsed the end: Heliod's spear cast down and broken.

events.summary: Storm-tossed Callaphe cries out to Thassa and tritons save her.
events.quote: Storm-tossed and broken, Callaphe cried out to deep-dwelling Thassa.

events.summary: Renata leads the best hunters of Theros against the terror of the Setessan wilds.
events.quote: Renata led the best hunters in all of Theros on a quest to bring down the terror of the Setessan wilds.

events.summary: Agios is felled by a minotaur's blade but is later seen in battle.
events.quote: Agios was felled by a minotaur's blade

relations.quote: Chosen by Heliod, Daxos approached the pegasus without fear

relations.note: followed her to a destined confrontation
relations.quote: Calix was patient, steadily following Elspeth until their destined confrontation.
